meta.notes: Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) unless flagged approx; highway waypoints from OSRM routing over OSM resampled every ~6 km (WGS84, 4 dp). Populations Census 2011 (municipal/town figures; village_cluster populations are rough estimates). Toll plaza positions approximate (snapped to route geometry); Punjab has closed several state tolls since 2022 so operational status varies. Facility coordinates (Moga main mandi, Adani Dagru silo, FCI depot, Verka Ludhiana) are approximate. Extra field 'lengthKm' on highways is routed length.

highways.name: NH-5 (Ferozepur–Moga–Jagraon–Ludhiana–Samrala–Morinda–Kharar–Chandigarh)
highways.notes: Old NH-95. Four-lane Ferozepur–Ludhiana (Ludhiana–Talwandi Bhai 4-laning) and Ludhiana–Kharar; 6-lane elevated Kharar–Mohali. Includes the Ludhiana–Chandigarh via Samrala route requested separately. Toll on Moga–Ludhiana/Ferozepur stretch not confirmed (none listed). Ghulal toll position snapped from OSM village location, approx. Geometry: OSRM route on OSM, resampled ~6 km; routed length 236.4 km, free-flow time 3.45 h.

highways.name: NH-44 (Jalandhar–Phagwara–Ludhiana–Khanna–Rajpura–Shambhu–Ambala)
highways.notes: Old NH-1 / GT Road; six-lane Jalandhar–Ambala. Punjab portion ends at Shambhu (Ghaggar) border; last point is Ambala Cantt. Toll positions approximate (snapped). Ladhowal is among India's highest-collecting plazas (s12). Geometry: OSRM route on OSM, resampled ~6 km; routed length 185.6 km, free-flow time 2.84 h.

highways.name: NH-703 (Jalandhar–Nakodar–Shahkot–Dharamkot–Moga)
highways.notes: Mostly 2-lane with paved shoulders; NHAI 4-lane greenfield Jalandhar–Moga project under tender/construction (2026), not modelled. Route via Dharamkot inferred from OSRM/OSM tagging (63 km tagged NH703). Geometry: OSRM route on OSM, resampled ~6 km; routed length 82.1 km, free-flow time 1.31 h.

highways.name: NH-703 (Moga–Badhni Kalan–Barnala)
highways.notes: NH-703 continues Moga–Badhni–Barnala–Mansa per Wikipedia; 2-lane. Geometry: OSRM route on OSM, resampled ~6 km; routed length 72.3 km, free-flow time 1.0 h.

highways.name: Moga–Bagha Purana (NH-105B) – Kotkapura (SH-16) – Bathinda (NH-54)
highways.notes: Designation uncertain: OSM tags Moga–Bagha Purana as NH-105B (spur of NH-5 to Bajakhana, s11); Moga–Kotkapura road historically SH-16 (Singhawala toll on it was made free, s15); Kotkapura–Bathinda is NH-54 (4-lane). Fastest Moga–Bathinda road (OSRM) is ~78 km via NH-105B/Bajakhana rather than Kotkapura (~104 km). Lanes: 2 to Kotkapura, 4 on NH-54. Geometry: OSRM route on OSM, resampled ~6 km; routed length 103.6 km, free-flow time 1.39 h.

highways.name: Zirakpur–Chandigarh–Mohali–Kharar urban arterial
highways.notes: Zirakpur flyover – Chandigarh (Purv Marg/Industrial Area) – Sector 17 – Mohali (Airport Rd/SH-12A) – Kharar. Urban, signalised in Chandigarh; no tolls. Geometry: OSRM route on OSM, resampled ~6 km; routed length 32.4 km, free-flow time 0.64 h.

highways.name: NH-7 (Bathinda–Rampura Phul–Barnala–Sangrur–Patiala–Rajpura–Banur–Zirakpur)
